<span style="color:#{{{1}}}">{{{2}}}</span><noinclude>

==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Color|{{Var|color}}|{{Var|text}}}}</code>

For coloring a specific portion of text.

===Required parameters===
#{{para||{{var|color}}}} The [[wikipedia:Web colors|hexadecimal color]] code&mdash;either three or six digits&mdash;without the number sign (#) beforehand.
#{{para||{{var|text}}}} The text to display in the given color.

==Example==
<code><nowiki>{{Color|FF0000|This text is red.}}</nowiki></code> produces {{Color|FF0000|This text is red.}}
